responsibility: This module implements GCC’s GNU Objective-C front end and its bridge to Objective-C runtime ABIs. It extends the C-family front end with Objective-C language registration and driver/build integration, defines ObjC-specific tree nodes and semantic actions for classes, categories, protocols, methods, properties, message sends, exceptions, fast enumeration, and @encode/@selector processing, and performs ObjC-specific diagnostics, tree construction, and gimplification. A major part of the module is the runtime interface layer: shared runtime hooks and metadata-building helpers cooperate with separate GNU-runtime and NeXT/Apple ABI back ends to lower message dispatch, constant strings, selector/class/protocol references, exception support, and final emission of Objective-C metadata in the layout required by each runtime. Supporting files also provide Objective-C type-encoding generation and lightweight semantic lookup maps, making this directory the core language-and-runtime implementation for compiling Objective-C source within GCC.
